title: agent-receipts: tamper-evident, third-party-verifiable receipts for AI agent / MCP tool calls
description: A minimal reference implementation of verifiable receipts for AI agent and MCP tool calls: a hash chain (integrity, zero-dependency) plus optional Ed25519 signatures (authenticity, third-party verifiable with the public key only). Includes an external-mediator mode (signs from outside the agent, closing the can-withhold-a-receipt gap), a verifier CLI, and an integration with the inspeximus memory core that makes memory writes tamper-evident. Honest scope: a reference proof-of-concept, not a hardened product; it credits the established 'Agent Receipts' protocol (Otto Jongerius), Microsoft's agent-governance-toolkit, pipelock, and the arXiv research in this space. Distributed on PyPI as 'agora-agent-receipts'. Part of the Agora project.
